signal: Hit a $3B valuation (TechCrunch, Nov 13). Public Ashby board has 102 jobs, including Enterprise Account Executive and Account Manager, Renewals & Expansion. Scored slightly down for size, up for ICP.
why_icp: The default agent framework. If agents need an email inbox and identity, LangChain is either a distribution partner or a huge customer. The live AE / renewals hiring is the second signal: they are scaling go-to-market around agents right now.
suggested_contact_title: Head of Partnerships or Head of GTM
first_line: The $3B valuation post and 100+ open roles, including enterprise AE and renewals, is a moment to give agents a real inbox, not another mailto hook.

signal: $350M raise at a $2.5B valuation for a viral AI assistant (Aug 26).
why_icp: An assistant that is supposed to act in the world eventually has to send and receive email as itself. That is AgentMail's category.
first_line: After a $350M raise, a viral assistant usually hits the wall where it needs its own inbox and identity, not a shared human mailbox.

signal: Announced a $60M seed from Benchmark and Index to build AI engines that own outcomes over weeks and months (company blog, Oct 2026). Also hiring a GTM Engineer.
why_icp: Engines that run for weeks need a way to communicate as themselves. Fresh seed capital plus a GTM Engineer search means they are about to stand up outbound and customer communication for agents.
suggested_contact_title: Founder or GTM Engineer hiring manager
first_line: A $60M seed to ship engines that run for weeks is usually when those agents need their own inbox, not a teammate forwarding mail.

signal: $45M raise (Nov 2) plus a live Ashby board (Founding Recruiter, Business Staff, intern roles posted Nov 5).
why_icp: They want nontechnical experts to work with models. That workflow gets a lot easier if an agent can send and receive email under its own identity.
first_line: The $45M raise to put model training in nontechnical hands is a natural time to give those workflows an agent inbox, not a personal Gmail.

signal: Raised $10M (Nov 6) to make digital environments real enough for robots.
why_icp: Earlier and more robotics than email, so scored lower. Still an AI-agent company that will eventually need machine identity for customer and vendor communication.
first_line: A $10M raise around robot-ready simulation is early, but the first customer workflows almost always need an agent that can send mail as itself.
